# src/net/authority.ts

<!-- Generated by scripts/document-code.mjs. Edit source contracts, then regenerate. -->

[Source](../../../../src/net/authority.ts)

GameAuthority: the one place that decides who gets an item, who drives a shared vehicle and
who has how much health. Games send requests and subscribe to the outcome, and never apply a
contested result themselves. RelayAuthority asks the relay (multiplayer); LocalAuthority
decides in-process with the same rules (single player). Requests: authority-schema.ts.

## Module dependencies

- `../simulation/combat/damage.js`
- `../math/frame/vectors.js`
- `./authority-schema.js`
- `./protocol.js`
- `./shared-entities.js`

## SwitchAuthority.constructor

[Implementation, line 257](../../../../src/net/authority.ts#L257)

One authority for the game's lifetime that forwards to the current one: LocalAuthority while
offline, RelayAuthority once joined. Switching removes the old authority's items (for nobody)
and replays the new one's, so a WeaponLoadout can keep a single authority.

```ts
constructor(initial: GameAuthority): instance
```

Direct call sites (syntactic references, not a purity or execution-order guarantee):
